Good food and great view
Sep 2026 • Solo
Having stayed in the hotel a number of times I thought I’d try out the Sail Rooftop. Great views access the river of the city. 

Men was the name of my waitress, super friendly and professional.

I ordered the chicken Caesar salad and the crab pasta, both were delicious, the bacon on the Caesar was a little too overdone for my taste but everything was great, the crab pasta was superb! Highly recommend this. 

Would recommend visiting here.
